pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Diode$() — a clean one-way repeater.$(li)$(bold)Latch$() — remembers a state (set/reset memory).$(li)$(bold)Pulse Gate$() — turns any input into a tidy single pulse.$(li)$(bold)Multiplexer$() — picks between two inputs based on a third (a selector).
